signal.name: Gemini Semantic Listening
signal.summary: The audio exhibits several characteristics common to AI-generated speech, including an unnaturally consistent cadence and speech rate, a significant lack of natural breathing patterns, and a slightly artificial timbre. These elements strongly suggest the voice was synthesized rather than being authentic human speech, resembling polished text-to-speech output.
signal.what_checked: Gemini listened for synthetic speech, cloned-voice artifacts, unnatural cadence, missing breathing, and generated-audio production patterns.
signal.what_found: The audio exhibits several characteristics common to AI-generated speech, including an unnaturally consistent cadence and speech rate, a significant lack of natural breathing patterns, and a slightly artificial timbre. These elements strongly suggest the voice was synthesized rather than being authentic human speech, resembling polished text-to-speech output.
signal.why_it_matters: When the dedicated wav2vec2 detector is missing or uncertain, Gemini gives the product a direct semantic audio review instead of stopping at an inconclusive model score.
signal.caveat: Gemini is an expert semantic judge, not a calibrated audio classifier. Treat this as one evidence signal in the trail.
observations: {'timestamp': '0:03-0:06', 'description': "The phrase 'but that is the reality of the situation' is delivered with an unnaturally consistent cadence and no audible breath, which is atypical for human speech."}

{'timestamp': '0:07-0:10', 'description': "The phrase 'Over time my voice will get closer and closer to the real thing' also lacks natural breathing cues and maintains a very even, almost robotic, speech rate."}

{'timestamp': '0:12-0:17', 'description': "The long sentence 'I am going to point out that no matter how I sound, this is all some crazy shit that is going down' is spoken without any discernible natural breaths, indicating a lack of physiological cues."}

{'timestamp': 'Throughout', 'description': "The overall timbre of the voice has a subtle artificial or 'phasey' quality, especially on sustained vowel sounds, which is characteristic of synthetic speech."}

signals.name: Voice Authenticity Model
signals.summary: This audio appears to be AI-generated (TTS/voice cloning). Confidence: 98%. Inference via local wav2vec2.
signals.what_checked: A fine-tuned Wav2Vec2-XLSR transformer (160M params) was used to classify whether this audio was recorded from a real human voice or synthesised by a text-to-speech / voice cloning system (ElevenLabs, Amazon Polly, Kokoro, etc.).
signals.what_found: The model classified this audio as a AI-generated voice with 98% directional confidence. Probability real: 2% | Probability fake: 98%.
signals.why_it_matters: AI voice cloning is increasingly used to fabricate statements by public figures. This check catches spectral artifacts in the audio that TTS models leave behind.
signals.caveat: The model was fine-tuned on 6 TTS engines. Novel cloning systems not in its training set may evade detection. Short clips (<2.5 s) or heavily compressed audio may reduce accuracy.

signals.name: Acoustic Micro-Signature
signals.summary: The voice shows natural micro-variation (jitter 5.07%, shimmer 22.14%), consistent with real vocal-fold behaviour.
signals.what_checked: We measured the physical micro-variation of the voice: pitch jitter, amplitude shimmer, harmonic-to-noise ratio, and spectral tonality.
signals.what_found: The voice shows natural micro-variation (jitter 5.07%, shimmer 22.14%), consistent with real vocal-fold behaviour.
signals.why_it_matters: Real vocal folds never repeat a cycle perfectly. Text-to-speech and voice clones tend to be smoother and more regular, so this measured signature is hard for a generator to fake without modelling true vocal physics.
signals.caveat: Heavy compression, noise reduction, and short or noisy clips can distort these measurements, so this is weighed with the other audio signals.
observations: Real human speech carries small, irregular variation from cycle to cycle. Synthetic and cloned voices are often smoother and more regular than a real vocal tract.
